name: GPU-Accelerated Volume Splatting With Elliptical RBFs
aliases: Modified Image-Aligned Splatting with Elliptical RBFs
definition: A volume rendering method that extends high-quality image-aligned sheet-buffer splatting to irregular grids using elliptical Radial Basis Functions (RBFs), accelerating the process on the GPU by rasterizing RBF slices onto sheet buffers.
summary: GPU-Accelerated Volume Splatting With Elliptical RBFs renders scattered volumetric data by slicing 3D ellipsoidal kernels into image-aligned planes, leveraging GPU rasterization for two orders of magnitude higher frame rates than fragment-centric methods.
